description: The D-pad on Access Roles' dashboard page in the TV layout (localStorage 'layout' = 'tv', html.layout-tv), as admin, reading only, with the Users tab remembered from an earlier visit (kit storage jfar:adminTab), which the page opens on: every tab is the D-pad's to reach (tabindex 0) and OK opens it; the Users tab's name buttons are focusable; OK on pageprobe-teen's name opens the panel with the focus inside it; the D-pad moves the focus through the panel (the kit's scopedKeys); OK on a role's checkbox ticks it and OK again unticks it; Back (Escape) closes the panel without saving and the focus is back on the name. accessroles-admin-page-probe.mjs gives pageprobe-teen the probe's lock-only role "Page probe Guest" first.

steps.name: the TV layout, and the Users tab remembered from an earlier visit
the module mounted: the tabs, the status loaded, the loading note hidden
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); return !!p && p.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]').length === 8 && p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesStatus table').length === 5 && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesScriptNote').hidden === true; })()

steps.name: the check's helpers
the page opened on the remembered Users tab (no import offered, no restore hold)
every tab in the D-pad's reach
the focus on the Users tab
the panel, the focus inside it
the role is shown ticked, its locks by the role
steps.assert: __arPage.check(__arPage.top(), "Page probe Guest").checked === true && [...__arPage.top().querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesUserOverrides .jfar-page-check-hint')].some(h => h.textContent === "Now: Locked by role Page probe Guest")

steps.name: the D-pad moved the focus inside the panel
the focus on the "Page probe Guest" checkbox
closed, the focus back on the name
nothing was saved
steps.eval: (async () => { const r = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('AccessRoles/Admin/Users')); const u = r.find(x => x.Name === "pageprobe-teen"); return u.RoleIds.length; })()

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
